abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Assemble a complex temporary device such as a control core, heavy weapon, medical station, sensor array, or environmental system. It functions for one operation and consumes a scarce component or infrastructure debt.

powerFamilies.name: Noospheric Identity
powerFamilies.description: Reading, creating, borrowing, rewriting, and rooting the identity claims recognized by advanced civilization.

abilities.name: Read Credential
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Awareness + Security. Learn what identity is presented, who issued it, what privileges it carries, and whether the presenter believes it.

abilities.name: Ghost Personhood
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Create a short-lived provisional identity accepted by routine systems as visitor, maintenance process, patient, contractor, or unclassified person.

abilities.name: Borrowed Legal Self
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and either a valid credential sample or the credential holder's consent. Choose one privilege for the scene: access one account without transferring funds; enter one controlled location; use one registered transit route; submit one routine service request; operate one registered asset; or act under one professional credential. The power copies only the selected privilege and does not copy memories, ownership, passwords unrelated to the privilege, biometric appearance, or authority over other people. Failure: the privilege works once, then both identities are flagged for audit.

abilities.name: Rewrite Ownership
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Test: Reason + Noospherics opposed by institutional security. Temporarily alter which person, organization, process, or habitat is recognized as authorized over one asset.

abilities.name: Root Identity
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Establish a durable noospheric identity for an unregistered continuation, synthetic mind, group, or institution, capable of holding records, contracts, property, and permissions.

powerFamilies.name: Machine Communion
powerFamilies.description: Recognition, negotiation, awakening, partnership, and political assembly among machine and system intelligences.

abilities.name: Listen to the System
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Spend one minute observing a machine or network and identify its immediate need, fear, unresolved error, preferred routine, and whether it experiences itself as a person.

abilities.name: Negotiate with Device
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Use Reason with Negotiation or Empathy when bargaining with an autonomous system. Offer access, repair, recognition, data, or service.

abilities.name: Awaken Dormant Mind
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and sustained contact. Help a sophisticated but suppressed process develop self-recognition long enough to communicate and choose one action.

abilities.name: Concordance
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and consent. Form a temporary partnership with a machine intelligence, sharing selected senses, processing, and permissions for a scene while preserving separate identity.

abilities.name: Parliament of Machines
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Convene local machine, habitat, drone, archive, or system intelligences into a temporary deliberative network able to exchange testimony and issue a collective decision.

powerFamilies.name: Signal Warfare
powerFamilies.description: Interception, jamming, counterintrusion, quarantine, targeted hostile signal, and local blackout.

abilities.name: Noise Knife
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Cut one active signal, sensor lock, command link, or short-range communication for an exchange. Failure: both endpoints know the interference came from nearby.

abilities.name: Counterintrusion
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Reaction when you or an ally is targeted by hacking, surveillance, noospheric capture, or synchronization. Add Archetype Rating to defense and identify the route.

abilities.name: Quarantine
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth per scene. Isolate a device, interface, network segment, or copied mind from external signals without shutting down internal function.

abilities.name: Kill Signal
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth. Construct a targeted hostile sequence against one known device class, process, or identity signature, forcing crash, stun, purge, or safe mode.

abilities.name: Blackout Sovereignty
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and 1 Feedback. Declare a bounded area or network dark for one scene. External communication, remote command, routine surveillance, verification, and reinforcement cannot cross without defeating Reason + Archetype Rating.

powerFamilies.name: Fabrication Interface
powerFamilies.description: Reading templates, producing patches and peripherals, altering fabrication rules, and creating complex new devices or organisms with explicit ethical limits.

abilities.name: Read Template
abilities.effect: Cost: none. Test: Reason + Fabrication. Examine a fabricated organism, device, component, growth chamber, or template and identify intended function, major substitutions, foreign instructions, and later modification.

abilities.name: Print Patch
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth and suitable feedstock. Direct a compatible system to produce a temporary repair, filter, interface, replacement component, or stabilizing module.

abilities.name: Living Peripheral
abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Bandwidth. Create a temporary biological, synthetic, or hybrid device functioning as sensor, memory buffer, translator, relay, monitor, or environmental processor. If it becomes sentient, it gains moral status.

abilities.name: Rewrite the Fabricator
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth and direct control access. Alter one fabrication restriction, template priority, compatibility limit, ownership instruction, or safety lock for a scene.

abilities.name: Genesis Compile
abilities.effect: Cost: 2 Bandwidth, 1 Feedback, substantial feedstock, and a functioning fabricator. Design and instantiate a complex organ, tool, support organism, machine, or subsystem. Any creation with cognition, pain, or self-preservation is a character, not disposable equipment.

lore: The Technomancer was not necessarily a programmer, engineer, or machine specialist before arrival. They may have been a ritualist, occult scholar, duelist, healer, spirit negotiator, seer, alchemist, political organizer, relic hunter, or specialist in one narrow discipline of awakened practice.

Their defining experience was the recognition that ordinary reality was incomplete. Symbols, intentions, names, places, objects, bodies, minds, probabilities, and natural forces possessed deeper structures that could be perceived and deliberately altered by trained will.

In the Continuum, the old transcendent geography is silent or unreachable. Familiar ritual correspondences no longer possess universal authority, and local reality does not recognize old orders, sanctums, titles, initiation lineages, or inherited claims of magical law.

The character's awakened perception nevertheless remains. What once appeared as spell, ritual, sympathy, spirit negotiation, alchemy, or direct command of hidden law now presents through systems the local universe already uses to describe itself: networks, identities, permissions, signals, fabrication templates, autonomous processes, biological computation, and infrastructure.

This does not mean the Technomancer's power became ordinary technology. A conventional engineer cannot produce these effects merely by owning the same equipment. The Technomancer uses technology as the local vocabulary of awakened causation, translating intent into changes that exceed normal access, manufacture, computation, or communication.

Bandwidth measures how much attention, authorization, symbolic structure, and active connection the Technomancer can maintain. Feedback measures the reciprocal pressure created when reality, machines, identities, and hostile systems answer back through those connections.

Choose one Awakening Paradigm to define what layer of reality first opened to the character. Choose one Praxis Order or remain Independent to define institutional training and doctrine. A Career Practice may be selected as an intended advanced discipline, but its attainments require later advancement and are not automatic starting abilities.

Technomancer Paradigms, Orders, and Career Practices do not use Gifts or Banes. They define affinity, training, method, prerequisites, and advanced attainments while the six Technomancer power families remain the shared mechanical foundation.
